name: Shop
description: Variants, prices in several currencies, stock, minimum order quantities, a cart and the cart sent as an inquiry, for a Mallok site.

buffer_rate.label: Exchange buffer
buffer_rate.help: Added on top of the exchange rate when a price is converted, to absorb rate movement and cross-border payment fees. 0.03 is 3%.

recalc_threshold.label: Repricing threshold
recalc_threshold.help: A converted price is recomputed only once the rate has drifted this far from the rate it was computed at. 0.02 is 2%.

rounding.label: Price rounding
rounding.help: How a converted price is rounded up to a price point: to the next .99, or to the next whole unit.

inquiry_recipient.label: Inquiry recipient
inquiry_recipient.help: The address that is told by email when a cart is sent as an inquiry. The email is sent from the site's own address (Settings → Email) and is answered straight to the buyer. Left empty, inquiries are only listed here in the admin.

inquiry_acknowledge.label: Confirm to the buyer by email
inquiry_acknowledge.help: Sends the buyer an email saying their request arrived, in their language. Off by default: the form has no challenge in front of it, so anyone can have that email sent to an address that is not theirs.

sku.label: SKU
sku.help: What a buyer quotes. The product page lists the sizes it names by SKU; a variant with another SKU is listed after them.

options.label: What distinguishes it
options.help: A name and a value, for example length and 10 mm. Shown where the product page has no words of its own for this SKU.

status.label: Status
status.help: An archived variant is on no page, and is taken out of every cart.

price.label: Base price, each
price.help: Leave empty for a variant that is quoted on request. Other currencies are derived from this at the day's exchange rate.

other_prices.label: Prices set by hand in other currencies
other_prices.help: A price here replaces the derived one and is never recomputed. It needs a base price above.

moq.label: Minimum order
moq.help: The least that can be ordered. On a page the quantity starts here, and any whole number from it up to 500 can be ordered. At most 500, which is the most one cart line may hold.

stock_policy.label: Stock policy
stock_policy.help: track: the stock below is a limit. made_to_order: always orderable, and the lead time is what the buyer is told.

stock.label: Set stock to
stock.help: Leave empty to keep the stock as it is — the figure in the list behind this form. Setting one records the difference in the stock ledger. A page says whether a size can be had, never this number.

sort_order.label: Position
sort_order.help: Lower comes first among the variants a product page does not name.

confirm.label: Delete these inquiries and their lines. This cannot be undone.
